create_workdir_config: create a WorkDir pydantic model to configure a custom working directory with files to copy
activate_workdir_context: activate a WorkDir context manager to copy files and change the working directory
use_chdir_context: use the chdir context manager to temporarily change the working directory and add it to sys.path
identify_package_path: identify the absolute path of a local file, folder, or editable Python package
create_ignore_filter: create an Ignore filter with include and exclude patterns for use with shutil.copytree
